concerns.text: FR-005 requires calculation of variance inflation factors (VIF) for predictor collinearity, but no task in tasks.md is tagged for or describes implementing VIF computation.
FR-011 mandates k‑fold (k=5) cross‑validation when deriving processing‑strategy labels; tasks.md contains a bootstrap stability check (T015) but no task implements the required k‑fold CV.

SC-001 expects a measurable dataset download success rate (≥95 % complete records) to be reported; tasks.md includes T010 for download but lacks any verification artifact or logging step that records this completeness metric.
